item.name: Dried Eyes
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: Eyedrops can also clear Death Ritual candles and temporarily calm the Mass of Eyes.
item.cardSummary: Use Eyedrops when the diagnosis screen shows Dried Eyes. Read the condition first, because a similar-looking supply is not a safe substitute.

item.name: Dehydration
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: IV Drops can also clear Death Ritual candles and appear at the start of Room 8 surgery care.
item.cardSummary: Bring IV Drops when a patient is diagnosed with Dehydration. Confirm the room before using them so the correct patient gets the supply.

item.name: Bruises
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: Medkits can also appear as requested supplies during Room 8 surgery care.
item.cardSummary: Use a Medkit for the Bruises diagnosis. This is normal patient care even though the same supply can turn up in surgery prompts.

item.name: Fever
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: Thermo is the treatment item name used by the current condition roster.
item.cardSummary: Match Fever with Thermo after the diagnosis finishes. The name sounds like a checking tool, but here it is the cure the patient needs.

item.name: Rashes
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: Ointment can also treat a patient after you put out their fire by hand.
item.cardSummary: Use Ointment for Rashes. Its fire-care use is separate, so still follow the displayed diagnosis during normal treatment.

item.name: Bleeding
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: Bandages use green cross artwork in the current version of the game.
item.cardSummary: Bring Bandages when the diagnosis is Bleeding. Use the item only after the condition appears on the room display.

item.name: Headache
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: Medicine is for Headache; Herbs are for Stomach Ache.
item.cardSummary: Use Medicine for a Headache diagnosis. This pair is easy to swap under pressure, so call out the condition before someone runs for supplies.

item.name: Stomach Ache
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: Herbs are for Stomach Ache; Medicine is for Headache.
item.cardSummary: Use Herbs for a Stomach Ache diagnosis. Keep this mapping separate from Medicine, which belongs to Headache.

item.name: Low Sugar
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: A patient with both Low Sugar and Canadian can request Maple Syrup twice. Maple Syrup also calms the Bed Monster.
item.cardSummary: Use Maple Syrup for Low Sugar. If Canadian also appears on the same patient, the game can require a second bottle even when one checkmark seems to cover both.

item.name: Canadian
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: A patient with both Canadian and Low Sugar can request Maple Syrup twice. Maple Syrup also calms the Bed Monster.
item.cardSummary: Canadian is a displayed diagnosis in Animal Hospital, and Maple Syrup is its treatment. It can appear with Low Sugar, so watch for a double request.

item.name: Flu
item.wrongTreatmentRisk: The patient dies and the hospital loses one life if you use the wrong treatment.
item.specialNote: Cough Syrup is the standard treatment tied to the Flu diagnosis.
item.cardSummary: Use Cough Syrup when the diagnosis screen shows Flu. Do not guess from the patient's appearance before the room finishes checking them.
